---
title: "BPPNM GFP ATAC-seq Analysis"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
#rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DESeq2)
#library(tximport)
library(readxl)
library("vsn")
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(pheatmap)
library(purrr)
library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(tracktables)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ChIPseeker)
library(RcisTarget)
library(UpSetR)
library(rGREAT)
library(msigdbr)
library(DT)
set.seed(10)
```

1. Load datasets
```{r}
dir <- "~/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/ATAC-seq/BPPNM GFP Int2 EMT ATAC"
meta <- read.table(file.path(dir,"Analysis/BPPNM_GFP_Meta.csv"), sep=",",header=T)
meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition)
rownames(meta) <- meta$Sample

# Load Htseq counts output
filenames <- list.files(path=file.path(dir,"Process/counts2/"),full.names=T)
filenames_short <- gsub(".htseq.count","",list.files(path=file.path(dir,"Process/counts2/"),full.names=F))
data1 <- read_tsv(filenames[1],col_names = c("id","Count"))
data_all <- filenames %>% lapply(read_tsv,col_names=c("id","Count")) %>% 
  purrr::reduce(full_join,by="id")
colnames(data_all) <- c("id",filenames_short)
data_all <- column_to_rownames(data_all,var="id")
data_all <- data_all[1:(dim(data_all)[1]-5),]
```
2. Run DEseq
2.1 Make DEseq object
```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(data_all, colData = meta, design = ~Condition) # Start with 115743 peaks
colnames(dds) <- meta$Sample
keep <- apply(counts(dds), 1, max)  >= 50 # Keep columns where >= one sample >= 50 counts
dds <- dds[keep,] # 80363 peaks remaining
dds
```
2.2 Run DEseq
```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)
resultsNames(dds)
```

```{r}
res.BPPNM_EMT <- results(dds, contrast=c("Condition","Mes","Epi"), alpha=0.05, lfcThreshold = 1)
summary(res.BPPNM_EMT)
```
```{r}
saveRDS(dds, file.path(dir, "Analysis/BPPNM_GFP_EMT_ATAC_DEseq2.rds"))
dds <- readRDS(file.path(dir, "Analysis/BPPNM_GFP_EMT_ATAC_DEseq2.rds"))
```

2.3 Run PCA and LFC shinkage
```{r}
# Data visualization using PCA
vsd <- vst(dds, blind=F)
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup=c("Condition"))
meanSdPlot(assay(vsd))
```
```{r}
resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="Condition_Mes_vs_Epi", type="apeglm")
resLFC
plotMA(res.BPPNM_EMT, ylim=c(-5,5))
plotMA(resLFC, ylim=c(-5,5))
```
```{r}
res.BPPNM_EMT <- res.BPPNM_EMT[order(res.BPPNM_EMT$log2FoldChange),]
res.BPPNM_EMT
summary(res.BPPNM_EMT)
res.BPPNM_EMT_signif <- res.BPPNM_EMT[(abs(res.BPPNM_EMT$log2FoldChange)>1& !is.na(res.BPPNM_EMT$padj) &res.BPPNM_EMT$padj<0.05),]
res.BPPNM_EMT_signif <- as.data.frame(res.BPPNM_EMT_signif)
```
3. Gene annotation for differential ATAC-seq and GO analysis 
```{r}
toOverLap <- promoters(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene, 500, 500)
res.BPPNM_EMT_over <- res.BPPNM_EMT[(!is.na(res.BPPNM_EMT$padj) & res.BPPNM_EMT$padj<0.05) & res.BPPNM_EMT %over% toOverLap, ]
makebedtable(res.BPPNM_EMT,"BPPNM_Mes_vs_Epi.html",file.path(dir,"Analysis/"))
```
```{r}
# Up .bed file
all_peaks <- readPeakFile(file.path(dir,"Process/macs2/all_peaks_cat_sort_merge_peak.bed"))
mes_peakup <- all_peaks[all_peaks$V4 %in% paste(rownames(res.BPPNM_EMT_signif[res.BPPNM_EMT_signif$log2FoldChange>0,]),""),]
mes_peakdown <- all_peaks[all_peaks$V4 %in% paste(rownames(res.BPPNM_EMT_signif[res.BPPNM_EMT_signif$log2FoldChange<0,]),""),]
write.table(mes_peakup,file.path(dir,"Analysis/mes_peak_up.bed"),sep="\t",quote=F,col.names = F,row.names = F)
write.table(mes_peakdown,file.path(dir,"Analysis/mes_peak_down.bed"),sep="\t",quote=F,col.names = F,row.names = F)
```

```{r}
anno_res.BPPNM_EMT <- annotatePeak(all_peaks, TxDb=TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
anno_mes_up <- annotatePeak(mes_peakup, TxDb=TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
anno_mes_down <- annotatePeak(mes_peakdown, TxDb=TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
# Visualize peak annotations
plotAnnoPie(anno_mes_up)
plotAnnoPie(anno_mes_down)
upsetplot(anno_res.BPPNM_EMT)
# GO enrich
go1 <- enrichGO(as.data.frame(as.GRanges(anno_mes_up))$geneId, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", ont = "BP", maxGSSize = 5000)
go2 <- enrichGO(as.data.frame(as.GRanges(anno_mes_down))$geneId, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", ont = "BP", maxGSSize = 5000)
mf1 <- enrichGO(as.data.frame(as.GRanges(anno_mes_up))$geneId, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", ont = "MF", maxGSSize = 5000)
mf2 <- enrichGO(as.data.frame(as.GRanges(anno_mes_up))$geneId, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", ont = "MF", maxGSSize = 5000)
head(go1, 10) %>% dplyr::select(ID, Description, pvalue, p.adjust) %>% datatable(elementId = "GO_Mes")
head(go2, 10) %>% dplyr::select(ID, Description, pvalue, p.adjust) %>% datatable(elementId = "GO_Epi")
```

3b. rGREAT enrichment analysis 
```{r}
h_gene_sets = msigdbr(species="Mus musculus",category = "H")
h_gene_sets = split(h_gene_sets$entrez_gene, h_gene_sets$gs_name)
h_gene_sets = lapply(h_gene_sets, as.character)
res_mes_up <- great(mes_peakup,h_gene_sets,"txdb:mm10")
res_mes_down <- great(mes_peakdown, h_gene_sets,"txdb:mm10")
plotRegionGeneAssociations(res_mes_up)
```
```{r}
mes_up_tb <- getEnrichmentTable(res_mes_up)
mes_down_tb <- getEnrichmentTable(res_mes_down)
head(mes_up_tb, 10) %>% dplyr::select(id, genome_fraction, observed_region_hits, fold_enrichment,mean_tss_dist,p_adjust_hyper) %>% datatable(elementId = "GO_Mes")
head(mes_down_tb, 10) %>% dplyr::select(id, genome_fraction, observed_region_hits, fold_enrichment,mean_tss_dist,p_adjust_hyper) %>% datatable(elementId = "GO_Epi")
write.table(as.data.frame(mes_up_tb), file=file.path(dir, "Analysis/rGREAT_mes_up.tsv"),quote=F, sep="\t")
write.table(as.data.frame(mes_down_tb), file=file.path(dir, "Analysis/rGREAT_mes_down.tsv"),quote=F, sep="\t")
```

4. Motif analysis
```{r}
# Generate gene list from DEseq2, then analyze motifs
geneList1 <- rownames(res.BPPNM_EMT_signif[res.BPPNM_EMT_signif$log2FoldChange>0,]) # Mes upregulated genes
geneLists <- GSEABase::GeneSet(geneList1,setName="Mes_Up")
motifRankings <- importRankings("~/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/RNA_seq/BPPNM_10xFlex_Pilot2/pySCENIC/mm10_10kbp_up_10kbp_down_full_tx_v10_clust.genes_vs_motifs.rankings.feather")
data(list="motifAnnotations_mgi")

# Run RcisTarget
motifEnrichmentTable_wGenes <- cisTarget(geneLists, motifRankings,
                               motifAnnot=motifAnnotations)
# RcisTarget takes in gene names, need to map peaks to genes first?
```
